description: The EL PAÍS body describes Jujuy mobilizations as permanent and roadblocks continuing for weeks, but does not date each distinct gathering or give attendance; onset and episode boundaries are unresolved. It cites Télam and CELS, which are attributed sources rather than independent confirmations.
required_followup: Seek contemporaneous event-level local reporting and organizer or rights-monitor reports specifying dates, localities, and single-gathering attendance.

description: Jujuy reform protests included separate marches, roadblocks and repression across different dates and localities. June18 EL PAÍS and later Radio Nacional reports establish ongoing activity, but event-level dates, sizes, boundaries and direct state-response links remain incomplete; June20 repression figures must not be assigned to June22 march.
required_followup: Find event-specific local reports for June16–21 and at individual localities; distinguish meetings, strike actions, roadblocks and separate gatherings, and corroborate state-response figures.

description: The June16 San Salvador march has qualitative threshold evidence from a local report but no numeric count or independent corroboration. Simultaneous route-blockade actions in other towns are separate units and their sizes are unknown.
required_followup: Seek local independent attendance reports for the city march and separate site-specific sources for other town gatherings.
